[[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] | preceded by = [[Something Wicked This Way Comes]] | followed by = [[Stemming the Skeletal Tide]] }} In [[Don't Fear the Reapers]] one must run across most of [[the Underworld]] to talk with all the [[Reaper]]s. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== * 1 [[Transmogrifier Tonic]] or [[Everlasting Transmogrifier Tonic]] ===Objectives=== * Travel to the [[Temple of the Ages]], [[Zin Ku Corridor]], or [[Chantry of Secrets]]. * Use a Transmogrifier Tonic and speak to the [[Voice of Grenth]] and gain audience in the Underworld as an [[agent of the Mad King]]. * Navigate through the Underworld as an agent of the Mad King to speak with all seven Reapers. You've consulted [0…7] Reaper[s] in your quest for the truth. *Travel to the [[Hall of Judgment]] to receive the Reapers' final report. * See [[Mad King's Steward]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *15,000 [[Experience]] *7 [[Phantasmal Tonic]]s *75 [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s ==Walkthrough== You must have used one [[Transmogrifier Tonic]] or its everlasting counterpart, or the Voice of Grenth will reject you. During this mission, you are an [[Agent of the Mad King|Agent of the Mad King]] and have 600 [[health]], 40 [[energy]], and 4 energy regeneration. {{:Agent of the Mad King}} *The Reapers can be consulted in almost any order, but there are ways to make the run most efficient: **[[Death|Dying]] causes you to [[Resurrection|resurrect]] back at the Underworld entrance with a 15% [[Death Penalty]] (which does not lower your maximum health nor energy) and no progress in the quest is lost (unlike in [[Halloween 2009]] where death resulted in a [[wipe]]). You can use this to your advantage by dying so you are sent back to the Underworld entrance with no disadvantage. **To save time, begin going to the next Reaper once the dialogue with a Reaper starts, since you do not have to wait for the dialogue to end for the quest to update. ***1. [[Reaper of the Labyrinth]] and [[Reaper of the Forgotten Vale]] should be done at the same time. ****To save time from having to run back to the Underworld entrance area to get to the next Reaper after consulting Reaper of the Forgotten Vale, let some foes near Reaper of the Forgotten Vale kill you to resurrect back at the Underworld entrance. ***2. a. If you have difficulty with the [[Bone Pits]]: then [[Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains]], [[Reaper of the Chaos Planes]], [[Reaper of the Spawning Pools]], and [[Reaper of the Bone Pits]] should be done in that order. ****If you have trouble getting to Reaper of the Bone Pits (who is the hardest to get to), it should be the last of these four Reapers to be consulted, since it will save time from not having to run back through the [[Twin Serpent Mountains]] from the Underworld entrance to get to Reaper of the Chaos Planes and Reaper of the Spawning Pools should you die from degeneration hex spells in the Bone Pits after consulting with Reaper of the Bone Pits. Even if you die upon triggering Reaper of the Bone Pits' dialogue, the quest will update the number of Reapers consulted (since your character's dialogue continues even when dead). If you consult Reaper of the Bone Pits and survive, to save time from having to run back to the Underworld entrance area to get to the next Reaper after consulting Reaper of the Bone Pits, let some foes near Reaper of the Bone Pits kill you to resurrect back at the Underworld entrance. ***2. b. If you do not have difficulty with the Bone Pits: then Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains, Reaper of the Bone Pits, Reaper of the Chaos Planes, and Reaper of the Spawning Pools should be done in that order. ****To save time from having to run back (and through the [[Tar]] again in the [[Spawning Pools]]) to the Underworld entrance area to get to the next Reaper after consulting Reaper of the Spawning Pools, let the Terrorweb Dryders near Reaper of the Spawning Pools kill you to resurrect back at the Underworld entrance. ***3. [[Reaper of the Ice Wastes]] should be consulted last so that you can go straight to [[King Frozenwind]] to complete the quest. *Use Sticky Ground to slow down groups of [[mob]]s that are close together (especially foes that attack in melee range). It is best to save its use for [[Grasping Darkness]]es (since they have a +50% speed boost) or when Sugar Rush is not active and recharging. *Use Sugar Shock to deal with stray mobs that come close to you or to interrupt [[spellcaster]]s such as [[Coldfire Night]]s. *Use The Mad King's Influence when you have a large number of foes around you or as a last resort if you get stuck in a group of mobs or a corner. **If you use The Mad King's Influence when surrounded by foes, get to a safe spot; they can still [[patrol]] and find you. **Wise use of The Mad King's Influence is important in getting to Reaper of the Bone Pits without getting hexed. When you know the foes' patrol paths, it takes 4 activations to get in and the same number (or 3 and 2 Sugar Shocks) to get out. *Hex spells from [[popup]] [[Mindblade Spectre]]s, [[Dead Thresher]]s, and [[Dead Collector]]s are particularly deadly, so make sure you knock them down or use The Mad King's Influence on them. *[[Consumable]]s that increase movement speed, such as [[Green Rock Candy]], [[Blue Rock Candy]], and [[Red Rock Candy]] are extremely useful to reduce the need to use Sugar Rush, provide a speed boost while waiting for Sugar Rush to recharge, and/or counter the speed reduction of Tar in the Spawning Pools. [[Essence of Celerity]] allows you to maintain Sugar Rush and The Mad King's Influence continually. Otherwise, use Sugar Rush whenever you need a boost to get past some mobs. Also, the effects of the aforementioned consumables are not removed upon death (unlike most other consumable effects), which synergizes with the run and die method mentioned above. Though without using any consumables, it is possible to complete in under 20 minutes. *It is possible to finish this quest using only The Mad King's Influence and Sugar Rush. == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ;Mad King's Steward ''[[Mad King Thorn]] appreciates your recent efforts on his behalf in the Underworld. However, he finds the report the tiniest bit suspect. I would never cast doubt on the word of King Frozenwind, but my master, the Indelible Fright, uses names like "fruitcake" more freely. He is certain that Dhuum was dealt with quite finally last year. He insists on a second opinion...or seven. The Mad King also insists on [[Royal Chef Culwich|Chef Culwich]]'s pie, but that's my problem, not yours.'' ''I wish to make use of your talents once again. While I shoulder the burden of pastry delivery, all you must do is travel to the Underworld and seek out the Reapers. Inquire of each Reaper their assessment of these dark stirrings. Be polite and diplomatic; Reapers respond well to courtesy. Report back to me when you have the information the Mad King seeks. As before, you will use a Transmogrifier Tonic to change yourself into an emissary of the Mad King. Once transformed, you may speak to the Voice of Grenth, who will send you to the Underworld. Of course, my lord will generously reward those who do his bidding. May the Mad King's luck be with you!'' {{offer dialog | accept = Here I go again on my own. | decline = I just remembered that I have to be somewhere far, far away from here. | ask = The Voice of Grenth will recognizes you as an emissary of the Mad King only if you are under the effects of a Transmogrifier Tonic. The Voice will send you to the Underworld. There you shall petition all seven Reapers for information and assistance. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== ;Voice of Grenth If not affected by [[Avatar of Sweetness]]: :''I was told an Agent of the Mad King was coming. You don't look much like one...'' If affected by [[Avatar of Sweetness]]: :''An agent of Mad King Thorn wishes to enter the Underworld alone? You are fortunate that the Reapers have the situation under control, for now. [[Grenth]]'s blessings be upon you.'' ::{{yes|ingame}} '''Let us do this!''' (sent to [[The Underworld (Don't Fear the Reapers)|The Underworld]]) ::{{no|ingame}} '''Sorry, I don't do déjà vu.''' '''When in range of [[Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains]]:''' :'''''': ''"Withered and fabulous Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains! I bring you cordial best wishes from Mad King Thorn. My liege requests your guidance."'' :'''Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains''': ''"Greetings, colorful candy creature. What guidance may I provide your lord?"'' :'''''': ''"The Mad King senses a disturbance in this realm. Watcher of the Cursed Brothers, do you know the cause and possibly the counteraction?"'' :'''Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains''': ''"Your deference pleases me. Tell the Grim Japer that the disturbance he senses is Dhuum. I shall travel to the Hall of Judgment to discuss with my fellow Reapers what remedy we may possibly hope for, though I think there be none."'' '''When in range of [[Reaper of the Spawning Pools]]:''' :'''''': ''"I bear greetings from Mad King Thorn to you, most excellent of all Reapers, custodian of the glorious and picturesque Spawning Pools. My lord has need of your vast knowledge and peerless wisdom."'' :'''Reaper of the Spawning Pools''': ''"Spare me your empty flattery, candy man. The deranged spirit you call master seeks knowledge of Dhuum, does he not?"'' :'''''': ''"Dhuum was the one thing he had previously ruled out, but I believe he'll find that knowledge invaluable now. How did you know what I sought?"'' :'''Reaper of the Spawning Pools''': ''"Hmph! I know all that transpires in the Underworld. You intend to ask me to meet with King Frozenwind and my fellow Reapers, do you not? Save your words, for already I depart for the Hall of Judgment."'' '''When in range of [[Reaper of the Chaos Planes]]:''' :'''''': ''"Salutations, dour one, sentinel of the Chaos Planes. I bring you best regards from Mad King Thorn. He desires your counsel on grim activity that may or may not be the return of Dhuum."'' :'''Reaper of the Chaos Planes''': ''"Quiet! Do you hear that...? It is the sound of the Void, calling to us. I thought him dead, but the Song of Dhuum heralds his coming."'' :'''''': ''"I'm sorry, but I don't hear anything except your confirmation of Dhuum’s rise. Will you attend a summit with King Frozenwind and your Reaper brethren? They gather even now at the Hall of Judgment."'' :'''Reaper of the Chaos Planes''': ''"That noise...both deafening and silent. It is the sound of Death beyond Death... I will travel to the Hall of Judgment, emissary, but I fear it may be too late."'' '''When in range of [[Reaper of the Bone Pits]]:''' :'''''': ''"Hail, noble servant of Grenth, sentry of the Bone Pits. I bring greetings from Mad King Thorn, who has heard grim rumblings from the bowels of the Underworld."'' :'''Reaper of the Bone Pits''': ''"I hear the same, but I can give them name: Dhuum's minions roam the Underworld with impunity, and in great numbers."'' :'''''': ''"You are most certain it is Dhuum? Knowing this, if you would deign to travel to the Hall of Judgment to offer King Frozenwind your counsel, Mad King Thorn would be eternally grateful."'' :'''Reaper of the Bone Pits''': ''"It is certain, sprite; as certain as Dhuum brings endless night. I shall go."'' '''When in range of [[Reaper of the Labyrinth]]:''' :'''''': ''"Greetings, O ancient and decrepit lord of the Labyrinth. I come on behalf of Mad King Thorn, who has sent me to learn what troubles these lands."'' :'''Reaper of the Labyrinth''': ''"Your master cannot read the signs? It is Dhuum, candy man. Death Inevitable. The Ender of All. The Mouth at the Edge of Darkness..."'' :'''''': ''"Please forgive my interruption, wise Reaper. Perhaps I could hear the rest of Dhuum's many names some other time? I will relay this to the Mad King. Perhaps you could travel to the Hall of Judgment to determine the gravity of our situation with King Frozenwind and your fellow Reapers."'' :'''Reaper of the Labyrinth''': ''"I will go and assess the threat posed by Dhuum, who some call the Omega Death... The Voice in the Void... The Final Judge..."'' '''When in range of [[Reaper of the Forgotten Vale]]:''' :'''''': ''"Greetings, O gaunt and mighty Reaper. I come on behalf of Mad King Thorn, who seeks to greater understand the threats to Grenth’s realm."'' :'''Reaper of the Forgotten Vale''': ''"Hail, emissary of the Autumn Lunatic. I know of what you speak."'' :'''''': ''"My master does not yet believe, but I imagine you will tell me it is Dhuum. If this is so, I beseech you to leave the Forgotten Vale and take counsel with King Frozenwind at the Hall of Judgment so we may judge the severity of the threat."'' :'''Reaper of the Forgotten Vale''': ''"What the Antic Harrower believes matters little in this place. I will travel to the Hall of Judgment, for it is Dhuum, and his threat is always grave."'' '''When in range of [[Reaper of the Ice Wastes]]:''' :'''''': ''"I salute you, O grand and frostbitten watcher of the Ice Wastes. Mad King Thorn has sent me to have his visions confirmed and clarified. Have you seen any troubles and do you know their root?"'' :'''Reaper of the Ice Wastes''': ''"Strange sights have I seen. Ominous portents have I heard on the chill winds. The hour of Dhuum may be at hand."'' :'''''': ''"Wise Reaper, we have need of you. Please travel to the Hall of Judgment and meet with King Frozenwind and your peers."'' :'''Reaper of the Ice Wastes''': ''"I shall go."'' '''In the [[Hall of Judgment]] after visiting each Reaper:''' :'''''': ''"Gathered Reapers, King Frozenwind, what may I relay from this conference to my lord?"'' :'''Reaper of the Chaos Planes''': ''"Tell the Mad King that Dhuum, subdued or awake, draws strength from each death in the Underworld. The ancient enchantments Grenth created to bind Dhuum to this place are weakening once again and soon may fail entirely."'' :'''''': ''"Have you something I can present to the Mad King as evidence of this threat?"'' :'''Reaper of the Bone Pits''': ''"The word of the Reapers is enough."'' :'''King Frozenwind''': ''"Didn’t I tell you it was Dhuum? I did. I’ll say it again: it’s Dhuum."'' :'''''': ''"Is there nothing we can do? Surely Dhuum's return is not inevitable!"'' :'''Reaper of the Ice Wastes''': ''"As inevitable as death itself."'' :'''Reaper of the Labyrinth''': ''"Go now, emissary of Mad King Thorn. Tell your master to prepare for the coming of the Ender of All, the Final Judge, Emperor of Oblivion, Master of Nothingness..."'' :'''''': ''"Thank you, mighty King Frozenwind. And my thanks to you, wise Reapers. If you'll excuse me, I must return to the Mad King's steward {{sic}} with this fateful news."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Mad King's Steward ''You have returned, and with grave tidings. I shall return to the Mad King and convey this certitude from our Underworld allies. Dhuum's reawakening is serious enough to interrupt pie time. I have a feeling we shall have need of your skills again soon. Until then.'' == Notes == *The [[Quest Log]] displays ''"Mad King's Steward (Lion's Arch)"'' even if your [[character]] acquired this quest in Kamadan. *During this quest: **A [[Resurrection Shrine]] (which appears on the [[Mission Map]]) [[spawn]]s at the Underworld entrance. **[[Charged Blackness]]es, [[Skeleton of Dhuum|Skeletons of Dhuum]], and [[Phantom Chest]]s do not spawn. **Foes do not appear to [[drop]] any loot. **Dying does ''not'' stop progress on the [[Survivor]] title. *You do not need to talk to the Reapers in the same order as the quest marker instructs you to, but you need to talk to all of them to complete the quest. *The quest will update the number of Reapers consulted even if you die before the end of the dialogue with one of the Reapers (since your character's dialogue continues even when dead). *You will be sent back to the earliest town or outpost of the starting campaign of your [[character]] when this quest is attempted after the end of the [[Halloween]] festival. The effect of the Transmogrifier Tonic is lost in this process. If started during the next Halloween, you can do the quest, but it will count for that year. *There is a short video tutorial of the Bone Pits section at [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iti4Uk_AeCg]. {{bug|In the German translation, all words are capitalized.}} {{bug|In the French translation, Reaper of the Labyrinth's dialogue does not make sense, speaking about the first step of the quest (using a Transmogrifier Tonic and speaking to the Voice of Grenth). }} {{bug|The door to the inside of the Hall of Judgment is visible but does not collide with other objects. You can walk through it to see the inside. This is useful if you are interested in seeing Dhuum's lair but cannot be bothered with the illimitable prerequisites.}} == Trivia == * This quest was introduced in [[Halloween 2009]] with a reward of 25 [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s, which was increased to 75 in [[Halloween 2010|2010]]. *The quest name is a reference to [[w:(Don't Fear) The Reaper|"(Don't Fear) The Reaper"]], a song by [[w:Blue Öyster Cult|Blue Öyster Cult]]. *The quest accept dialogue is a reference to [[w:Here I Go Again|"Here I Go Again"]], a song by [[w:Whitesnake|Whitesnake]]. * The [[/2009|original]] objectives and dialogue were rewritten in 2010.
